card.name: Digits inside years and phone numbers
card.fires_on: Mostly a digit in the middle of a year or phone/zip number, such as the 7 in 2017 or the 2 in 2012. It also fires weakly on a few scattered words like 'or', 'one' and 'most' in running text.

modes.label: Digits in dates and numbers
modes.description: A digit partway through a year, zip code, phone number or standard number.

modes.label: Partway through a word
modes.description: A piece in the middle of a longer word such as psychometric or psychiatric.

modes.label: Scattered linking words
modes.description: Small words like 'or' or 'one' inside a list or phrase.
